hero.heading: Let's talk
hero.intro: Tickets, tables, nominations, sponsorship or media — our team is happy to help.

sponsorship.heading: Sponsor the Sankofa Royale Awards
sponsorship.body: Put your organisation alongside an evening that celebrates Black excellence and funds real community programs. Sponsorships can include an honouree award, a table, the red carpet or the photo experience — we will shape a package that fits your goals.
points: Recognition on stage and in event materials
Tables for your team and guests
Visibility with community, business and civic leaders
A direct contribution to CAWAP's programs

form.heading: Send us a message
form.successMessage: Thank you — your message has been sent. We will get back to you shortly.
